notes.title: Early Access 1.1 Patch
notes.content:
[p]This is the first proper patch to the game.   [/p][p]- Added a way to return from loadout 
- Added core controls to options menu 
- Added disabled story button 
- Added version number to corner of menu 
- Fixed Quit button on lose menu 
- Fixed Standard build having incorrect starting stats 
- Started work on Core powers (still in progress)[/p][p]If you encounter any issues, Join our discord and let me know![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/VGaCPy38ta"]https://discord.gg/VGaCPy38ta[/url][/p]

notes.title: Fullscreen Toggle added.
notes.content: It was brought to my attention that a fullscreen mode would be helpful so I added it right away. New toggle found in options menu.

notes.title: Day one patch
notes.content: Just fixed the missing project files to allow the game to launch!

notes.title: Game now in Early Access!
notes.content: [p]Here is a link to our community discord. Please feel free to join and drop some feedback. Any and all feedback on the game is welcome [url="https://discord.gg/VGaCPy38ta"]https://discord.gg/VGaCPy38ta[/url][/p]
